svg.title: Validate current content and publish atomically
svg.desc: A bounded Saga lock serializes writes. Current story edits validate references and replace one complete value; legacy migration preserves exact pins.
svg.text: Validate current content and publish atomically
A bounded Saga lock serializes writes. Current story edits validate references and replace one complete value;

g.text: Complete authored request
Flags inherit omitted current story fields; structured input
supplies complete content. Neither path authors Saga revision
IDs or parent lists.
Strict requirements load
The requirements domain loads strictly. Current story revise
reloads under the lock; other writer paths retain their existing
preflight and legacy normalization behavior.
Bounded writer lock
Cooperating writers serialize on the Saga root and receive a
bounded busy error rather than waiting forever.
Validate current target
After locking, the writer validates current content, lifecycle
constraints and referenced personas/citations. An already-
current story skips unrelated legacy normalization.
Atomic current replacement
A validated current content/state value replaces current.json
atomically. The identity and unedited state remain stable; Git
records earlier committed bytes.
Refuse invalid content
Malformed requirements, invalid references and ambiguous legacy
migration fail before target publication. Relative diagram edits
separately reject an outdated digest.

svg.text: Stable identities · exact evidence pins · Git-owned committed history
